items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: he sent everybody else on and gave me the job... I worked with him

ctx.x: 1706 -- between 17th and 18th on Central Avenue. And I had always heard, as I expressed earlier, that I had been to -- I only knew New Orleans like 3½ or something, you know, 3 years old. But I always heard how clannish the black people from Louisiana were, you know, they really were always together.

And it came up for Papa Mutt -- he had an audition that where he needed a drummer, you know, so all these drummers went over on West Pecos someplace -- it's over near Georgia Street, I remember, there was a club over there -- but that was where he was holding his audition. And about 4 drummers, they played, for him -- and here I come, you know,
